import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { issues } from "../../../backend/schema/issues";

// A board over "status" fits this table, but a board needs a text column to keep each card's order in. Add one, then declare kanban: { columnField: "status", orderField: "<that column>" }.
export const issuesCms = customizeTable<typeof issues>("issues", {
    display: {
        title: "reportableType"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "status", "assignedRole", "reportableType", "resolvedAt", "reportableId"],
    fields: {
        reportableType: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "status",
        "assignedRole",
        "reportableType",
        "resolvedAt",
        "reportableId",
        "reportsCount",
        "reportedUser",
        "resolvedByRelation",
        "updatedByRelation",
        "createdAt",
        "updatedAt"
    ]
});
